answer.content: After two independent reviews confirm the absence of any directly observable, non-feature-based mechanisms for temporal continuity in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, the inquiry remains unanswerable as framed. The sources do not describe temporal smoothing or state interpolation, nor provide proxies for implicit temporal continuity without feature extraction. A bounded revision is required to restrict the analysis to only explicitly stated, verifiable phenomena in the text without inference or external assumptions. The current request lacks sufficient evidence to advance further without narrowing the scope to direct, non-abstract claims in primary sources.
